capability_assessments.implication: Authentication, receipt hashing, idempotency, normalization, risk routing, and monitoring exist, but no genuine TradingView alert has produced external delivery evidence.
No qualified live-venue adapter proves client IDs, acknowledgements, retry semantics, fills, balances, positions, fees, reconciliation, or kill switches against a selected execution venue.
Immutable chronological bar replay, realistic modeled costs, walk-forward evaluation, and rejection evidence are operational for compatible bar-based strategies.
Aurex has not qualified complete revision-bound tick or sequence-aware L2 evidence with disconnect recovery for a selectable short-horizon, passive, arbitrage, or options mechanism.
Evidence-grade costed paper execution and risk controls exist, but no eligible strategy has opened a forward campaign and no long-duration external operation has qualified them.
Starting capital, maximum tolerable loss, daily stop, and research or data budget are not frozen, so capacity and risk design cannot be economically or operationally grounded.
The intended venue, jurisdiction, KYC account state, permitted spot or derivatives products, API access, and restrictions are not evidenced; public data access cannot substitute.
The rejected trend_pullback_v1 v1.3 package has not completed trade-level TradingView parity, so the local engine still lacks an externally compared Pine-semantics proof.

Modeled costs support conservative bar research, but complete historical account-tier fees, filters, product state, margin, settlement, and venue rules are not qualified for new execution-sensitive mechanisms.
Every completed candidate is rejected or retired and V3/V4 selected zero primaries; Aurex currently has no positive net expectancy claim, eligible strategy, or profit basis.
No selected venue and account have completed deterministic sandbox order lifecycle, balance, position, fee, reconciliation, monitoring, stale-data, and kill-switch drills.

required_operator_decisions.required_value: Document whether a verified account exists, its KYC state, API availability, permission scopes, and sandbox or testnet access.
required_operator_decisions.why_it_blocks_successor_discovery: Adapter design and execution feasibility depend on the actual account's capabilities; public documentation and market data cannot prove account-specific access.

required_operator_decisions.required_value: Set the maximum one-time and monthly amount available for historical tick/L2 data, metadata, storage, and transfer.
required_operator_decisions.why_it_blocks_successor_discovery: Microstructure, arbitrage, and options research repeatedly failed on free-source completeness; a budget determines whether those families are feasible or must remain excluded.

required_operator_decisions.required_value: Name the exact exchange and account environment intended for future sandbox and, only after qualification, micro-live use.
required_operator_decisions.why_it_blocks_successor_discovery: Fees, symbols, filters, order semantics, market access, APIs, maintenance behavior, and legal restrictions are venue-specific.

required_operator_decisions.required_value: Set absolute total, daily, per-trade, and evidence-breach loss limits that Aurex may never exceed.
required_operator_decisions.why_it_blocks_successor_discovery: No capital-protection or capacity policy is meaningful without a human-owned maximum loss boundary independent of hoped-for returns.

required_operator_decisions.required_value: Choose spot-only, spot plus perpetuals, or another explicitly legal and account-enabled product set; do not assume leverage.
required_operator_decisions.why_it_blocks_successor_discovery: Product scope determines required data, financing, margin, liquidation, settlement, tail-risk, and execution foundations.

required_operator_decisions.required_value: Set the capital actually available for eventual micro-live use, excluding emergency funds and without borrowing.
required_operator_decisions.why_it_blocks_successor_discovery: The first $100 milestone, minimum order sizes, fees, capacity, drawdown limits, and realistic time horizon cannot be designed without a real capital denominator.

limitations: A paid data budget would enable investigation, not guarantee a selectable mechanism or profitable strategy.
A venue account and API access would enable sandbox evidence, not live-trading eligibility.
No TradingView mutation is authorized by this artifact; explicit human authority remains mandatory.
No positive edge, reliability, expected profit, time-to-profit, or first-$100 probability is claimed.
No successor discovery, network request, market import, parameter, return, candidate, paper eligibility, sandbox eligibility, live eligibility, or capital permission exists.
Rejected v1.3 parity validates engine semantics only and cannot promote or rescue the rejected strategy.
This review diagnoses capability and operator-input gaps; it does not propose or select a trading mechanism.
Webhook delivery evidence must terminate at paper-safe rejection while no strategy is eligible.
